title: Spring 2026: Cards, Dashboard, and Payment Upgrades
body_markdown:
Hi there,


A few upgrades worth knowing about.


## ⚡️ 2% Back on Every Card Purchase


Live since May 1. Every swipe on your Truss charge card earns 2% back. Real money back in the business. No tiers, no caps, no hoops.


## 🛠️ Revamped Dashboard


The home screen got a full refresh. Cleaner layout, key account info front and center, and a more intuitive experience right when you log in. Less digging, more doing.


## 📲 Tap to Pay Improvements


We shipped a handful of mobile upgrades: 2FA auto-submits the moment you type the last digit, the payment screen is cleaner with clear success confirmation, and empty states actually feel finished. Small details, big difference.


## 💳 Pay Bills with Your Credit Card


*(Coming soon!)* Fund any bill payment with your credit card and stretch your cash flow on your terms. Perfect for floating payroll, materials, or that big invoice until the money lands.


[See what's new →](https://app.trusspayments.com/dashboard/accounts)
